reason: My team already keeps everything in a spreadsheet and it works well enough. I would open the trial to look, but I will not pay 89 dollars a month when I have to move all my data myself.
objection: Moving my data from Excel or amoCRM will take weeks and nobody will do it for me. 89 dollars a month is a lot when I earn about 13,000 a year, and I would check two other vendors first.
would_change_my_mind: Free data migration from my spreadsheet, plus a price near 30 to 40 dollars a month, with the trial running long enough for my team to really use it.
